title: What Can We Learn from Toddlers?

blanks.sentence: Toddlers learn to move and make sense of the _____.
blanks.section: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS — Early development

blanks.sentence: Being unable to do what they want can leave them feeling _____.
At this stage, a child's _____ begins to develop.
For everyday care, two- or three-year-olds still rely on _____.
A toddler's self-talk may help reduce _____ in an anxiety-provoking situation.
As people grow up, their inner voice often becomes _____.
Adults who feel angry with themselves can imagine speaking to a _____.
Adults can learn to treat themselves with greater _____.

multipleChoice.question: Why does the idea of learning from toddlers initially seem surprising?
options: They can explain their feelings more clearly than adults can.
They still need adults to meet many basic needs.
They are already able to manage most daily tasks alone.
They learn mainly by copying adults' spoken advice.

multipleChoice.question: What do the examples of the mitts and the boots show together?
options: Toddlers speak to themselves both to encourage themselves and to acknowledge mistakes.
Toddlers need an adult to correct each small mistake.
Toddlers learn to dress by repeating the same task silently.
Toddlers become anxious whenever clothing is difficult.

multipleChoice.question: How does the discussion contrast toddlers' and adults' inner voices?
options: Toddlers' inner voices are private, whereas adults' are usually spoken aloud.
Toddlers rely on praise from others, whereas adults rely on their own judgment.
Toddlers' self-talk is usually critical, whereas adults' is encouraging.
Toddlers' self-talk tends to encourage, whereas adults' may become critical.

multipleChoice.question: An adult makes a small mistake and begins insulting themselves. Which response best applies Dr Merali's advice?
options: "I made a mistake; I can learn from it and try again."
Ask a good friend to decide what should be said next.
Stop thinking about the situation until the anger passes.
Repeat the mistake aloud to understand its cause.

multipleChoice.question: Why is learning to get dressed used as an example near the end?
options: It shows why young children often depend on adult care.
It illustrates how toddlers avoid difficult tasks.
It shows how toddlers value small achievements.
It illustrates how toddlers develop their personalities.
